Name: Flaschendrehen: Das Partyspiel
Overview:
The iconic party game – now on console!

The game where you can make a complete fool of yourself in front of your gathered friends or find out their funniest and most intimate secrets. It breaks the ice at any gathering—there are plenty of wacky tasks to complete, and the "Truths" force everyone to reveal embarrassing facts and come out of their shell. The competition keeps things exciting, and the bonus games are designed so you can really stitch up your fellow players.

Single players or teams can compete against each other, laughing at over 1,000 questions and tasks while collecting points. For example:
"Have you ever asked someone: 'How was I?'"
"Send the text 'I love you!' to the 8th person in your phone book!"
"Go out onto the street and do the Chicken Dance!"
"Swap shirts with the player to your right!"
"Ring the neighbor's doorbell non-stop for 30 seconds!"
"Kiss the 3rd person to your left."

The "Spin the Bottle" feature goes around the circle. But after you decide on the difficulty level (10, 20, 30 points for Truth questions – 40, 50, 60 points for Dares), a random generator selects which category (Love, Sports, Chaos, etc.) the next question will come from.

Features:
Over 1,000 dares and questions.
Collect points easily with Truth questions by chatting about your most private details.
Or collect more points with Dares, accepting the risk that you might spend the next few rounds with your neighbor's pants on your head.
An "Embarrassment Barometer" announces how risky the upcoming questions are.
Use a Joker twice to save yourself from total humiliation and use it to really catch out the others.
Full Voiceovers: All questions are spoken aloud—so no need to just read off the screen.
A random generator mixes up new challenges every time.
Easy to operate using the remote control or keyboard, displayed large and clear on your TV or monitor.
